title: Senior Developer - .NET, Angular, React
description:
**Overview**
**Senior Developer**
**Location:** 
 Kolkata, India
 **Work Model:** 
 Hybrid – 3 Days per Week in Office
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Developer is responsible for the overall performance of the product by applying principles of software engineering to the design, development, maintenance, testing, and evaluation of software. This role ensures the timely delivery of high\-quality software within release timelines and guidelines, while providing technical mentorship and influencing engineering standards across the team.
   

  

 This is a great opportunity for an experienced engineer who thrives on solving complex problems, driving technical excellence, and making a meaningful impact on both product and team.
   

  

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
* Develop complex code based on functional specifications; complete logic and algorithm design in alignment with established standards, translating software requirements into clear and precise design specifications.
* Perform complex peer code reviews and analysis; provide insight on the broader impact of software changes while incorporating business value and influencing technical direction for other team members.
* Test code to verify it meets technical specifications and is working as intended; create and apply automated tests and test principles to software changes, including unit tests.
* Influence and lead team standards, processes, and events — including planning, work estimation, solution demos, reviews, and implementation design discussions.
* Research complex escalations for production issues or software code issues to ensure application stability; implement development standards to ensure compliance with product and industry practices and regulations.
* Mentor, coach, train, and provide feedback to team members; make recommendations for internal process improvements and product documentation based on a thorough understanding of business applications and coding tasks.


**Technology Tools**
**Category**
**Tools**
**Frameworks**
* NET, Angular, React


**Programming Languages**
 Java, C/C\+\+, C\#, Python, JavaScript
   

  

**Development Environments**
 Windows, Linux
   

  

**Platforms**
 Open Source Tools \& Platforms
   

  

**Engineering Practices**
 Build Environments, Delivery Pipelines
   

  

**Testing \& Integration**
 Test Automation Tools, Continuous Integration (CI) Tools
   

  

**AI Principles**
 MCP, RAG, Agentic AI
   

  

**Role Essentials**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with significant experience in one or more general\-purpose programming languages, including Java, C/C\+\+, C\#, Python, or JavaScript.
* Experience with data structures, algorithms, software design, and continuous software delivery in Windows/Linux development environments using open source tools and platforms.
* Demonstrated experience with build environments, delivery pipelines, test automation, and continuous integration tools.
* Strong critical thinking, problem\-solving, and analytical skills with a strong attention to detail and the ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
* Strong oral and written communication skills with a professional demeanor; demonstrated ability to influence, motivate, and mobilize team members and business partners.


**What We'd Like To See**
* Experience with .NET and Angular/React frameworks; strong ability to translate goals into the implementation of new ideas and design solutions.
* Driven to learn and stay current professionally; passionate, competitive, and intellectually curious with sharp technology curiosity and aptitude.
* Experience in software application testing tools, methodologies, and process frameworks; ability to contribute to a delivery pipeline inclusive of test automation, security, and performance.
* Strong ability to provide technical and constructive feedback to team members; experience mentoring junior developers and fostering a collaborative, high\-performing team culture.
* Good ability to establish rapport and gain the trust of others; effective at gaining consensus across teams and with stakeholders at all levels.


**About Hyland**
 Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation. © Hyland. All rights reserved.
   

  

 Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including many of the Fortune 100, Hyland's solutions create the foundation for a connected, agentic enterprise, where teams harness the power of AI to redefine how they operate and engage with those they serve. For additional information on Hyland's platform and services, please visit Hyland.com .
   

  

**\#HylandLife**
 Since 1991, it has been Hyland's mission to help our employees, customers and partners exceed their potential with our industry\-leading content services platform . Our employees exude a contagious energy and are passionate about what they do – whether it's helping customers succeed, raising up their fellow Hylanders, or engaging in the communities where they live and work.
   

  

 The \#HylandLife hashtag encompasses our employee\-centric culture. Our employees live our culture day in and day out by bringing their best self to work. Hyland supports them to do just that through career development resources, wellbeing programs and innovation practices. We thrive on diverse viewpoints and new ideas and believe that a positive, inclusive workplace is imperative to sustainable success.
   

  

 As we've grown to a company of nearly 4,000 strong, we have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our communities . We strongly support employee initiatives and align our giving campaigns and programs to organizations that are important to them.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
 Hyland is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations. Information collected during the hiring process is used solely to assess qualifications, verify identity, and comply with legal requirements.

title: Shopify & CRO Specialist
description:
**Role at a Glance** 




**Team \- Website \& Conversions** 




**Location \- Hybrid \- Park Street Kolkata** 




  





**What this role actually does** 





 The Shopify \& CRO Specialist owns website performance for a portfolio of D2C brands. This role improves conversion rates through theme edits, landing page builds, A/B testing, and page speed work — sitting at the intersection of design, code, and data.
 




  





**About Studio APS** 





 Studio APS is a performance marketing agency based in Kolkata. We manage crores in annual ad spend across Meta, Google, and Amazon for fast\-growing D2C brands. We work in pod structures, go deep on fewer brands, and focus on measurable growth outcomes.
 




  





**Your week, roughly** 





 • Edit and build in Shopify — theme customisations, new sections, landing pages
 





 • Run CRO audits to identify where customers are dropping off in the funnel
 





 • Set up and analyse A/B tests on product pages, checkout, and landing pages
 





 • Optimise page speed and Core Web Vitals across assigned brand accounts
 





 • Improve product pages — layout, copy, trust signals, size guides, reviews
 





 • Build ad\-specific landing pages in collaboration with the media buying team
 





 • Support the SEO team with technical site fixes
 





 • Report on conversion metrics monthly and recommend next actions
 




  





**What we are looking for** 





 • 2\+ years working hands\-on in Shopify — you should be comfortable in the theme editor
 





 • Basic Liquid knowledge is a strong plus
 





 • You understand what makes a D2C product page convert, not just how it looks
 





 • Familiarity with Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar heatmap tools
 





 • Detail\-oriented — you notice checkout friction before the client does
 





 • Agency experience managing multiple client accounts preferred
 




  





**Why Studio APS** 





 • Work across a diverse portfolio of fast\-growing D2C brands
 





 • Direct collaboration with media buyers — your work is tied directly to revenue
 





 • Small team, real ownership, no bureaucracy
 





 • Build skills across Shopify, CRO, and performance marketing in one role
 




  





**Where this role leads** 





 Strong CRO performers grow into Senior CRO or Head of Website roles. Cross\-functional growth into media buying or brand strategy is possible for the right person.
 




  





**How we work here** 





 Fully remove / On site both roles available. In\-office collaboration in Kolkata is welcomed and preferred for onboarding and team reviews.
 




  





**How to Apply:** 





 Fill out the form: https://forms.gle/6gf5XS4Sqf6uRSJz6
 




  





**Visit Our Careers Page** 





 https://studioaps.in/careers
 




  






 Alternatively Interested candidates should submit their resume, a cover letter detailing their experience and qualifications, and a portfolio or samples of previous work to info@studioaps.in. Please include "Shopify \& CRO Specialist" in the subject line. Linkedin Easy Apply is not preffered.

title: ServiceNow - Moveworks AI - Manger
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Manager**
 As part of our EY GDS\-ServiceNow team, you will work to solve client problems using ServiceNow platform. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problem.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Lead Architect with expertise in ServiceNow Implementation and specifically Moveworks AI to join the EYD GDS ServiceNow. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
   

  

 The architect designs and owns the “AI front door” experience for employees, where Moveworks acts as the primary conversational layer over ServiceNow processes.
   

  

 Ensure natural language requests raised in Teams/Slack/Employee Centre are accurately translated into governed ServiceNow workflows.
   

  

**Key focus areas**
* Designing intent\-to\-action mappings between Moveworks AI Assistant and ServiceNow (ITSM, HRSD)
* Structuring knowledge bases, service catalog items, and record producers to be AI\-consumable
* Reducing ticket intake by enabling autonomous resolution for L1/L2 use cases (passwords, access, FAQs)


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Performs Configuration/Customization of the ServiceNow system, including creation workflows
* Architecting end\-to\-end AI agents that combine:
+ Moveworks Reasoning Engine
+ ServiceNow workflows, approvals, and policies

* Defining when the AI resolves fully vs. hands off to human agents
* Designing reusable agent patterns (HR)
* Performs integrations and process automation using Orchestration, Web Services, Soap calls, etc.
* Load, manipulate and maintain data between ServiceNow and other systems as needed
* Gathers specifications from the business departments and delivers a product/release that meets the needs presented. Interprets business and functional requirements and develops technical specifications documentation
* Work with business liaison to generate dashboards, home pages, performance analytics data collectors and reports as needed
* Must analyse and fully understand user stories and internal procedures to improve system capabilities, automate process workflows and address scheduling limitations throughout the development and delivery of the ServiceNow releases
* Own Architectural reviews, quality reviews and technical documentation
* Performs system and integration testing with sample and live data


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Deep understanding of Moveworks AI Assistant \& Enterprise Search
* Experience designing conversational flows that replace portals/forms
* 
* Hands\-on experience with Moveworks–ServiceNow integration architecture
* Authentication protocols such as IAM/Active Directory / LDAP or SiteMinder federation /Azure
* Integrating with internal and external applications and systems
* JavaScript, HTML, Angular JS and good web design practices
* Implementation experience on any of the following applications on ITSM, HRSD, Service Portal, Agentic AI, Gen AI.
* Disciplined Agile Delivery software release build/deploy processes


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 10\+ years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* ServiceNow CSA certification is mandatory, CIS\-HRSD is favourable


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience on SDLC or TFS or JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* Knowledge about ServiceNow’s latest version’s features.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1000\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY ServiceNow practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
